name: Ostkustleden Etapp 8, Hällveberg - Lilla Hycklinge
description: Hällveberg to Lilla Hycklinge. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Hällveberg well: Well on/near the cabin yard. Official page/maintainer recommend boiling water. Do not model as guaranteed potable tap water.
Lilla Hycklinge water: Water in the Lilla Hycklinge cabin/house area. Verify seasonal/current status before user-facing drinking-water claims.
notes: Current Naturkartan display uses Hällveberg, but URL/GPX filename and OSM relation use Hedvigsberg. Hällveberg cabin page reconciles this by stating Hedvigsberg is the older name and Hällveberg is current on maps. Döderhult also contains Hälveberg spelling in places.
Naturkartan says 16.9 km, normalized GPX computes about 16.834 km, PDF/Oskarshamn round to 17 km, OSM computes about 16.76 km but tags 18 km, and Döderhult says cirka 18 km.
Official GPX contains eight pieces, but raw order creates jumps and duplicate sliver tracks 2 and 7. Correct sequence is 8 -> 4 -> 3 -> 1 -> 5R -> 6R.
Naturkartan Etapp 8 Hitta hit/stage marker is mid-route, not start or endpoint.
Normalized official GPX endpoint is 156.4 m from the Lilla Hycklinge cabin marker, while the official description says the section ends at the trail entrance/overnight cabin.
Naturkartan says Kungliga Vitterhetsakademien acquired Stensjö by in 1963, while Döderhult says owned since 1960.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Hällveberg
facilities.description: Etapp 7/8 endpoint cabin, formerly Hedvigsberg, now Hällveberg on maps. Simple cabin for Ostkustleden hikers, about 10 beds per secondary/maintainer context, simple kitchen, well, dry toilet, no electricity and no outdoor fires. Boil well water.

facilities.name: Hällveberg well
facilities.description: Well on/near the cabin yard. Official page/maintainer recommend boiling water. Do not model as guaranteed potable tap water.

facilities.name: Stensjö by kulturreservat / village
facilities.description: Cultural reserve and village through which Etapp 8 passes. Owned/managed by Kungl. Vitterhetsakademien, with Länsstyrelsen as supervisory authority. Marked trails cross grazing areas; reserve rules apply.

facilities.name: Stensjö by toilets
facilities.description: Toilets at Stensjö by. OSM tags reportedly include free, 24/7, flush and wheelchair-designated.

facilities.name: Stensjö by picnic site
facilities.description: Picnic/rest point in Stensjö by service cluster.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Lilla Hycklinge
facilities.description: Final Etapp 8 cabin and Etapp 1 start-area cabin. Red cabin left of the yellow house by the parking area, water in the house, toilet in nearby building, grill ring outside if no fire ban. Fee 100 SEK/person in cabin and 50 SEK/person tenting by cabin.

facilities.name: Lilla Hycklinge water
facilities.description: Water in the Lilla Hycklinge cabin/house area. Check seasonal/current status before user-facing drinking-water claims.

facilities.name: Lilla Hycklinge toilet
facilities.description: Toilet in the building between the red cabin and the yellow house.

facilities.name: Hycklinge Naturcenter parking
facilities.description: Free parking near the Lilla Hycklinge cabin and bus/Närtrafik stop, between Etapp 1 and Etapp 8.
